note: ranges and defaults of convert.py / stream.py; hard limits (the format or the board cannot do it) stop with an error, recommended ranges only warn

board.note: UNO 16 MHz, ST7789 on 8 MHz SPI; a segment = one writeWindow (window + clipping), cycles counted like lib/GIF/source/config.json

screen.note: the biggest screen of this project (M130T); pictures are clipped, so bigger is only wasted data

uno.note: pixels in flash (output/*.h), drawn by image::FlashImage

mac.note: pixels stay on the computer (output/mac/*.h), stream.py sends them to image::StreamImage; the board only has the size and the path (output/*.h); 256 colors would need 512 B RAM on the board
